astarot-managed-source.service:
# ASTAROT managed microphone v1; created by ASTAROT
[Unit]
Description=ASTAROT managed audio endpoint
After=pipewire.service wireplumber.service
[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStart="/usr/bin/pw-loopback" "--name" "astarot-managed-source" "--channels" "1" "--channel-map" "MONO" "--capture-props" "{\"node.virtual\": true, \"astarot.managed.route\": \"v1\", \"astarot.managed.owner\": \"astarot-service-v1\", \"priority.session\": -100, \"state.restore-props\": false, \"media.class\": \"Audio/Sink\", \"node.name\": \"astarot.managed.mix\", \"node.description\": \"ASTAROT Managed Virtual Microphone Input\"}" "--playback-props" "{\"node.virtual\": true, \"astarot.managed.route\": \"v1\", \"astarot.managed.owner\": \"astarot-service-v1\", \"priority.session\": -100, \"state.restore-props\": false, \"media.class\": \"Audio/Source\", \"node.name\": \"astarot.managed.source\", \"node.description\": \"ASTAROT Managed Virtual Microphone\", \"node.passive\": true, \"node.param.Props\": {\"mute\": true}}"
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
TimeoutStopSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
